package.description: Discotheek changes your screen into a night club spotlight.

en-US.description: Discotheek changes your screen into a night club spotlight.
en-US.longDescription:
Discotheek - Use your monitor(s) as spotlight
Discotheek changes your screen into a night club spotlight. You can use your it to generate multicolor flashes or strobe. Discotheek supports multiple screens. You can run Discotheek on Windows, macOS, Linux and online.
en-US.name: Discotheek
